result.instructions: Tools for Papierkram, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my invoices are still unpaid, and for how much?"; "Show my expense vouchers from last quarter for supplier Hetzner."; "How many hours did I track on project Website Relaunch this month and are they billed?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Papierkram data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run papierkram_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run papierkram_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run papierkram_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. papierkram_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: papierkram_create_company
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact (company) in Papierkram. Papierkram assigns the customer number. Nothing is sent to the contact. Check papierkram_list_companies first to avoid duplicates. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

delivery_method.description: How documents are delivered to this contact.

tools.name: papierkram_update_company
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing contact (only the fields you pass are changed). Read it first with papierkram_get_company.

delivery_method.description: How documents are delivered to this contact.

tools.name: papierkram_create_person
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact person to an existing company. Nothing is sent to the person. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

tools.name: papierkram_create_project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project for a customer. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

customer_id.description: Company id of the customer (from papierkram_list_companies).

budget_type.description: Budget kind; then pass budget_money or budget_time.

tools.name: papierkram_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a time-tracking task in a project. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

proposition_id.description: Product/service id the time is billed with (from papierkram_list_propositions).

user_id.description: User assigned to the task (from papierkram_list_users).

tools.name: papierkram_create_time_entry
tools.description: WRITE: record a time entry (worked time) on a task. Not billed until an invoice is made. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

unbillable.description: True when the time must not be billed.

tools.name: papierkram_create_proposition
tools.description: WRITE: create a stored product or service (Leistung/Artikel) with a price. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

time_unit.description: Time unit used for time tracking with this item.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate as Papierkram writes it, e.g. 19% (see vat_rate.name of an existing item from papierkram_get_proposition).

tools.name: papierkram_create_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT outgoing invoice (state draft; it is NOT finalized or sent, and gets no invoice number until the user completes it in Papierkram). Needs a payment term id (papierkram_list_payment_terms) and at least one line item. Use papierkram_list_invoices afterwards to check it. Costs Papierkram API credits (a create 10, an invoice 50; the monthly quota is limited).

customer_id.description: Company id of the customer (from papierkram_list_companies).

contact_person_id.description: Contact person of the customer (from papierkram_list_persons).

supply_date.description: Supply/service date or period as text, e.g. 01.10.2026 - 14.10.2026.

gross.description: False (default): prices are net. True: prices are gross.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.19 for 19%, 0.07 for 7%, 0 for none.

price.description: Net unit price (or gross when gross is true: see price_gross).

discount_percentage.description: Discount as a fraction, e.g. 0.1 for 10%.

proposition_id.description: Stored product/service this line is based on (from papierkram_list_propositions).
